# Om Biswas Portfolio

> The creative portfolio of Om Biswas, a visual, UI/UX, and product designer studying at Symbiosis Institute of Design. Exploring brand identity, 3D collectible toys (Kaali Peeli), and digital experiences.

## Core Navigation

- [Home](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/): Interactive portfolio showcasing hero animations, philosophy, skills, and featured work.
- [Featured Works](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/#work): Curated assignments in UI/UX design, 3D hardware design, and brand experiences.
- [Sketchbook](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/#sketchbook): Interactive 3D Moleskine journal with ideation notes, character mascot print specs, and toy design sketches.
- [About](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/#about): Design philosophy, creative approach, and visual arts background.
- [Skills](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/#skills): Creative toolkit including Figma, Procreate, Blender 3D, After Effects, and Antigravity.
- [Curriculum Vitae](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/#cv): Comprehensive resume, experience, education at Symbiosis Institute of Design, and achievements.
- [Contact](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/contact): Direct communication channels, social profiles, and collaboration inquiries.

## Featured Projects

- [PlayStaples Kaali Peeli](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/#work): Handcrafted wooden toy collectible celebrating the iconic Mumbai Premier Padmini taxi, featuring 3D product CAD visualization, custom livery, physical packaging, and brand storytelling.
- [Aureus Audio](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/aureus): Luxury audiophile e-commerce and hardware lookbook with isometric product telemetry, 3D modeling, and interactive case study.
- [Oni Design Studios](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/#work): Cyberpunk character mascot design, holographic print production, and corporate identity system.
- [Melody Concert Ticketing](https://omisbrain.vercel.app/#work): End-to-end desktop UI/UX concept for a live music and concert ticketing platform, featuring atmospheric discovery, split-theme event lineups, two-column checkout, and vibrant 3D periwinkle visual framing.
